title: Structure-informed Language Models Are Protein Designers

layout.note: Six lettered panels: A and B side by side at top-left with C beneath, D and E side by side at the top right, and a large shadowed frame F at the bottom right that receives hollow block arrows from D and E.

lesson: Draw the two model families you join as small background boxes with their own tints and data-size badges, then reuse those tints inside one large shadowed overview panel so the new model reads as their join; add a long return arrow with a loop icon for iterative inference.
